parameters.description:
`msg-to-plivo-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Plivo destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Plivo destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Plivo destinations bound per enrollment.

Sign up for a Plivo account at plivo.com; from your account you can generate your Auth ID — set it as PLIVO_SMS_AUTH_ID. Set PLIVO_SMS_FROM to a phone number registered to your Plivo account, and PLIVO_SMS_TO to the recipient's number — both in E.164 format (e.g. +15555550123).
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"src": "${ customer_secrets.PLIVO_SMS_FROM }", "dst": "${ customer_secrets.PLIVO_SMS_TO }", "text": {* _escape_json((_body.title or "") .. ((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_body_template_plus: {"src": "${ customer_secrets.{{ params.from_secret }} }", "dst": "${ customer_secrets.{{ params.to_secret }} }", "text": {* _escape_json((_body.title or "") .. ((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Plivo destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Plivo number
parameters.summary: Send an SMS to your own Plivo destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

auth_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Plivo auth id

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's PLIVO_SMS_BASIC value (same format as PLIVO_SMS_BASIC)

from_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's PLIVO_SMS_FROM value (same format as PLIVO_SMS_FROM)

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's PLIVO_SMS_TO value (same format as PLIVO_SMS_TO)
